cards.title: Kiss-Kiss
cards.text: You must kiss another player of the opposite sex. If you take a shot, you may choose whom you kiss, otherwise the other players choose.

cards.title: Tattoo
cards.text: You must get a sharpie tattoo on your body drawn by another player. If you take a shot, you may choose where you get the tattoo.

cards.title: Never Have I Ever…
cards.text: Five strikes, loser drinks 5.

cards.title: Beer Bitch
cards.text: For the remainder of the game, you must get a beer or drink for any player who requests one.
cards.flavor: 80% of the time this is Joe.

cards.title: Stoop Kid
cards.text: You must sit on the stoop of the building for one round. Players will call you back into the room when it is your turn again.
cards.flavor: Stoop kid's afraid to leave his stoop!

cards.title: Get out of Jail Free
cards.text: You may use this card to save yourself or a fellow player from answering a question or participating in a card.

cards.title: T-Rex
cards.text: You must hold your arms in the position of the infamous T-Rex for two rounds. Take a shot to make it last for one round.

cards.title: Remote Control
cards.text: You now have the ability to control any other player with commands found on a remote control for one round. Example: Players may be muted for a round.

cards.title: Self-Explanatory
cards.text: Give someone a dollar or shotgun a beer or take a shot.

cards.title: Taboo
cards.text: Choose three words. Any player who says one of the three words drinks. This lasts for the remainder of the game.

cards.title: Self-Explanatory
cards.text: People wearing a different color shirt than you must drink 5.
cards.flavor: You learn to wear a brown button down shirt.

cards.title: Dunce
cards.text: You must sit or stand facing the corner for one round.
cards.flavor: Give a shot if you wear a cone on your head.

cards.title: Get Spanked
cards.text: You must get spanked by another player. If you take a shot, you may choose which player spanks you.

cards.title: Social
cards.text: Everyone drinks.

cards.title: No Names or Nicknames
cards.text: If a player says another player's name or nickname, they drink 2. Lasts 1 round.

cards.title: Self-Explanatory
cards.text: Finish your drink or take off an article of clothing.

cards.title: Copycat
cards.text: You must copy every player's card for one round.

cards.title: Dude
cards.text: You may only say "dude" for the remainder of the game.

cards.title: Chug Challenge
cards.text: You must challenge any player to chug a drink of your choice. The winner slaps the loser.

cards.title: JG Wentworth
cards.text: You must open a window and yell "It's my money and I need it now".

cards.title: Shoe Hands
cards.text: You must wear your shoes on your hands for one round.

cards.title: Speak in an Accent
cards.text: You must speak in an accent chosen by the other players for one round. Every time you speak without the accent you must drink.

cards.title: Self-Explanatory
cards.text: First person to laugh drinks 6.

cards.title: Coin Flip
cards.text: Heads you drink five, tails you give 7.
cards.flavor: If I flip this coin, what's the chance of me getting head?

cards.title: SLOOT
cards.text: You must call a person of the opposite sex from your favorites or recently called numbers. The phone must be on speaker. Call them a sloot and hang up without explanation.
cards.flavor:
When a sloot is blowing me? Definitely not a bad thing.
-- Thad Castle

cards.title: Pants Time Capsule
cards.text: Every player puts one item in your pants. Your eyes must be closed, but players may hand you items so that you may place them in your own pants. At the end of the game, you may remove the items.

cards.title: Teamwork
cards.text: Everyone must hold hands for an entire round. Hands may only be broken to allow a player to participate in another card.
cards.flavor: I'd like to lead you all in some swaying.

cards.title: Swap
cards.text: You must swap your shirt and pants. If you are unable or unwilling, you must reverse the order of clothing, i.e. underwear is now the top layer.
cards.flavor: Why do superheroes wear their underwear on the outside?

cards.title: Ice Ice Baby
cards.text: You must hold an ice cube in each hand until they melt.
cards.flavor: Dum dum dum da da dum dum.

cards.title: Player Count
cards.text: Count the number of players, then drink that many.

cards.title: Movie Train
cards.text: Name a movie. The next player must name an actor in that movie. The next player must name a movie that the actor is in. Repeat pattern until someone loses.

cards.title: Phone a Color
cards.text: Call a friend, and ask them to name a color with no explanation. Everyone wearing that color must remove that article or clothing or take a shot per article of clothing they keep on.

cards.title: Coaster Rule
cards.text: You must hold your drink in your hand for two rounds.
cards.flavor: At least you can't get fingered…

cards.title: No Touch
cards.text: You may not touch your legs or face for one round. Each touch is equal to one drink.

cards.title: Sext and Tell
cards.text: Send a sexually inappropriate text to someone of the opposite sex from favorites or recently texted numbers. Take a shot to choose what is texted, otherwise the other players decide.

cards.title: Troll
cards.text: Sit under the table for one round.

cards.title: You have been Turned to the Dark Side.
cards.text: You must drink anytime someone else does for one round (except shots).

cards.title: Spin the Bottle
cards.text: Grab a bottle and give it a spin.

cards.title: Misery Loves Company
cards.text: You may choose a card that has already been played and give it to another player to repeat.

cards.title: Reverse, Reverse!
cards.text: The game is now played in the opposite direction around the circle.

cards.title: The Janitor
cards.text: Clean the table of any empty drinks or food items for the rest of the game.

cards.title: The Understudy
cards.text: You must now drink for the person on your left and right for one round.

cards.title: Hobbit Leaving the Shire
cards.text: Grab three friends and take a lap around the building.

cards.title: Stone Age
cards.text: Turn off all electricity in the room (lights, music, phones, etc.). Lasts for two rounds.
cards.flavor: Someday I want there to be an electric railroad in the stone age.

cards.title: The Contest
cards.text: Challenge any player to a contest of your choice. Loser must chug a beer.

cards.title: Snake Eyes
cards.text: Any time a player looks you in the eyes, they must drink one. Lasts for one round.

cards.title: Sex Mannequin
cards.text: Choose two players and place them in a sex position of your choice. Players must remain in position until it is one of their turns.

cards.title: Pregame
cards.text: Drink before everyone else's turn for one round.

cards.title: Cheers (Mothafucka)
cards.text: Everyone of your sex must drink 2.

cards.title: Waterfall
cards.text: The player on your left starts the waterfall, ending with you.

cards.title: New Best Friend
cards.text: You must find another person to join the game. It may be a friend or a stranger. For every round the player is not present, drink 5.

cards.title: Prohibition
cards.text: No player may say anything related to alcohol for two rounds. Players who do must drink two per word. This means you can't say drink, drunk, alcohol types, or name brands.
cards.flavor: We sell blocks of dried grapes. But don't put it in water and let it soak for two weeks, because then it would turn into wine, and that would be illegal.

cards.title: Change of Cup
cards.text: Players must decide on an unusual drinking container that you must use to drink from for the remainder of the game. The container may be cleaned before use.

cards.title: Boob Tap
cards.text: Tap the nearest boob.

cards.title: In the Pocket
cards.text: You must place your hands in the pockets of the players to your left and your right for one round.

cards.title: TMNT
cards.text: Name all four teenage mutant ninja turtles. Drink 4 for each turtle you miss.

cards.title: Paparazzi
cards.text: Find a stranger and get a photo with them. If you fail to do so in one round drink 5.

cards.title: Truth Card
cards.text: Last time you cried?

cards.title: Truth Card
cards.text: What is the most trouble you have been in with the law?

cards.title: Truth Card
cards.text: Name a person or celebrity of the same sex you would be gay or lesbian for.

cards.title: Truth Card
cards.text: Most embarassing drunk story?

cards.title: American Idol
cards.text: Sing everything you say for one round. Drink one for everything not sung.

cards.title: Homeless Man
cards.text: You have one round to collect 67 cents. Drink 7 if unable.

cards.title: Maple Syrup Shot
cards.text: Take a shot of maple syrup. In the unfortunate event that pure Vermont maple syrup is unavailable, a condiment of the other players' choice must be substituted.
cards.flavor: Better to drink Everclear than New Hamsphire maple syrup.

cards.title: Fire Drill
cards.text: Everybody switch positions in the circle.
cards.flavor: Firetrucks don't stop for red lights.

cards.title: Crush
cards.text: Admit to having or have had a crush on someone in this room. Drink six if you refuse or haven't had a crush.

cards.title: The Great Outdoors
cards.text: You must go outside the next time you have to use the restroom.

cards.title: Heat Wave
cards.text: Whatever you are drinking must be placed in the microwave for 20 seconds. Use the appropriate containers (no cans in the microwave).

cards.title: Moose
cards.text: Last person to put up antlers drinks 3.

cards.title: Gingivitis
cards.text: All gingers must drink 3.

cards.title: For the Love of Boy Bands
cards.text: Other players choose a boy band from the 90s. Name all members. Drink four for every missed member.
cards.flavor: Everyone will get at least one person if you choose NSYNC.

cards.title: Fall in
cards.text: The players to your left and right must join you in standing at attention for one round. Drink four for any break in formation.

cards.title: The Floor is Lava
cards.text: The floor has become lava to you for one round. Drink three per touch.

cards.title: Gettin' Fingered
cards.text: Every person's drink who is one finger length from the edge of the table must drink 3.

cards.title: Wild Card
cards.text: Make a rule of your choice.

cards.title: Wild Card
cards.text: Make a rule of your choice.

cards.title: Truth Card
cards.text: What would you say is each players' best attribute?

cards.title: Wrong Number
cards.text: Each player will give you a single digit to enter into your phone. Once you have seven digits, add your area code before and hit dial on speakerphone. For every minute on the phone with the stranger, you can give out five drinks to the other players. Take a shot beforehand and you may choose a different area code than your own.

cards.title: Supersize That
cards.text: For one round, every time you have to drink, you must drink twice that amount.

cards.title: Mike Tyson
cards.text: Get a tribal tattoo on your face. Take a shot and you can use a washable marker or eyeliner.

cards.title: Starstruck
cards.text: Name a famous actor or actress that has starred in numerous films. Starting with you, everyone must go around and name a movie they were in. The first person to fail to name a movie drinks three.

cards.title: Over and Out
cards.text: You must end every sentence with "over" for two rounds. Drink one for every missed over.

cards.title: Bad Moonshine
cards.text: You must get blindfolded for one round.

cards.title: Shut the Front Door
cards.text: Drink once for every time you swear. Lasts two rounds.

cards.title: Now That's Using your Head
cards.text: Keep your forehead on the table for one round.

cards.title: Name Chain
cards.text: "You name a famous person. The next person names a famous person starting with the letter of the last name of the person previously said. The first person to mess up drinks four. Example: Bill Clinton, Clint Eastwood, Emma Watson, etc."

cards.title: The Cow
cards.text: In a double shot glass mix one shot of milk and one shot of alcohol of your choice.
cards.flavor: There's an easy way out of this.

cards.title: Boy Meets World
cards.text: Call each girl in the room Topanga. Drink 3 every time you mess up.

cards.title: Chubby Cheeks
cards.text: You must go to the fridge and place three items in your mouth. Take a shot to decide which objects, otherwise the other players choose. Items must remain in your mouth for one minute.

cards.title: Professor Oak
cards.text: You have become professor Oak. You may not say anything nice and you must be unnecessarily critical of everyone's actions and/or attire. Lasts one round.
cards.flavor: This is my grandson. He's your rival. Uhh... what's his name again?

cards.title: Blizzard Bra or Boxers
cards.text: Go outside and place a snowball-size amount of snow in your boxers or bra. Take a shot and you can pick another player to join you.

cards.title: Sobriety Checkpoint
cards.text:
You must pass three sobriety tests.
1. Stand on one leg and count to ten without falling.
2. The player on your left makes up a test.
3. The player on your right makes up a test.

cards.title: Sex Change
cards.text: If you are a male, you must get eight fingernails painted. If you are a female, you must get a fake unibrow drawn on you. Take a shot, and males can get only three nails and females can get it drawn in eyeliner.

cards.title: It's a Me, Mario!
cards.text: You must get a mustache that resembles Mario's. Take a shot and it can be drawn in washable marker or eyeliner.

cards.title: What?
cards.text: You may only speak in questions for one round. Drink once every time you mess up.

cards.title: World's Most Interesting Man
cards.text: You can only speak in terms of "I don't always ____, but when I do I ____" for one round. Drink two every time you fail.

cards.title: Polyjuice Potion
cards.text: You must get a cup and have everyone pour a splash of what they are drinking into your cup. Drink said cup of mixed drinks.

cards.title: Twi-Hard's Eternal Love
cards.text: Other players choose a player that you must sit in front of and stare into their eyes for one round. Drink one every time you lose eye contact.

cards.title: #Hashtag
cards.text: You must include the word "hashtag" in each sentence. Failures result in a drink.

cards.title: Electric Railroad
cards.text: Everyone must put a hand on the ceiling. Everyone who takes a hand off of the ceiling (except for the last player) takes a shot.
cards.flavor: This is why the green line is late.

cards.title: Massachusetts Hole
cards.text: Everyone not from Massachusetts drinks 4. If your name is Dan Etter, take a shot instead.

cards.title: Triple Dan
cards.text: Do three shots of decreasing proof alchool within ten seconds.

cards.title: Minister of Foreign Affairs
cards.text: You are the only player allowed to communicate with people not playing the game for the rest of the game.
cards.flavor: The Secretary of State is the American equivalent.

cards.title: Green Mountain Boys
cards.text: Finish any unfinished drinks on the table.

cards.title: The Royal We
cards.text: You must refer to yourself in the magestic plural (*e.g.* We need a refill.) for three rounds. Drink every time you mess up.

cards.title: No Pointing
cards.text: If you point you drink.

cards.title: Gecco
cards.text: Everyone must place three limbs on a vertical surface. The last one to do so drinks 3.
cards.flavor: But does London dispersion forces doe.

cards.title: Polite Society
cards.text: Every time a player tells someone to drink, the player giving the drink must compliment the other player.

cards.title: Diglett
cards.text: Dig deep and finish your drink.

cards.title: Iced
cards.text: Take a knee and chug a Smirnoff ice. If there is not one available, the other players decide what you drink.

cards.title: Panhandling
cards.text: Perform all actions in slow motion until your next turn.

cards.title: Permission
cards.text: Whenever someone opens a drink, they must ask you for permission. If they forget, they must finish the drink.

cards.title: Multitasking
cards.text: Finish your drink while taking off your shirt (if your shirt is already off, you may take off another article of clothing). Any clothes you spill on must also be taken off.

cards.title: Add a Card
cards.text: Add a card to the deck.
cards.flavor: Whoever is holding the phone can add it for real.

cards.title: New Love
cards.text: Kiss the player on your left on the lips. If you refuse, finish your drink and theirs. If they refuse, they finish their drink and yours.

cards.title: Boring
cards.text: Spice up the game. Choose a player to remove an article of clothing.

cards.title: Faptitude
cards.text: Take a drink from the cup of each player you have masturbated to.

cards.title: Question Master
cards.text: For one round, players must answer any questions you ask in the form of a question. Drink two for each time they mess up.

cards.title: The old Reddit Switcharoo
cards.text: Switch a piece of clothing with a player of your choosing.

cards.title: Have you ever?
cards.text: Five drinks, everything must be explained. First one out must do a dare.

cards.title: Cup Check
cards.text: All players must keep one hand over their genitals for one round.

cards.title: Love of Science
cards.text: If you aren't a major in any field of chemistry, biology, physics, or math or you aren't single, drink.

cards.title: Mad Men
cards.text: Put on nicer clothes and be unnecessarily mean to all women.

cards.title: Pokémon Master
cards.text: Name as many of the original 15 pokemon types as you can in 30 seconds. Drink two for each type you miss; if you miss 5 or more, finish your drink and your new name is Joey.

cards.title: Less boring
cards.text: For every shot you take, you may make another player remove an article of clothing.

cards.title: Let it breathe
cards.text: All players with zippers on their pants must unzip them now. Any player whose pants are already unzipped must drink 3.

cards.title: Scout's Honor
cards.text: For one round, you must be completely honest.

cards.title: Lose-Lose Situation
cards.text: Choose another card. All players must perform that card.

cards.title: Carded
cards.text: If your ID is not on your person, take a shot.

cards.title: Aced
cards.text: If you do not have an ace card on your person, remove your pants.

cards.title: Slut card
cards.text: Drink once for every sexual partner you have had.

cards.title: Nay thou!
cards.text: Every player must point at another player. The player with the most people pointing at him or her must drink 4.

cards.title: Vodka for my ladies, Whiskey for a Grown Man
cards.text: Men not drinking whiskey take a drink. Ladies drinking whiskey give a drink.

cards.title: Lederhosen
cards.text: Put on a pair of suspenders. If no suspenders are available, improvise suspenders.

cards.title: Jersey Shore Style
cards.text: The first person to stop fistpumping must get painted orange, have a six pack drawn on them, or have their hair geled up.

cards.title: Jinx
cards.text: You are jinxed, and cannot speak. When someone says the name of someone who is jinxed, they are jinxed, and the person whose name is said is no longer jinxed.
cards.flavor: And you owe me a coke.

cards.title: Tourettes
cards.text: You must include a swear word in every sentence. Drink whenever the swear is the first or last word in the sentence.

cards.title: Rock Slide
cards.text: Hide under a blanket until your next turn.

cards.title: Rule
cards.text: Make a rule.

cards.title: Lick!
cards.text: The last person to lick someone takes three drinks. If nobody licks anyone, everyone takes four drinks.

cards.title: Don't be Hatin'
cards.text: Draw another card. Everyone must do what's on the card.

cards.title: Gambling Man or Woman
cards.text: Make a bet with another player. Bet at least two drinks.

cards.title: Pokémon Test
cards.text: Name as many of the original 15 pokémon types as you can in 15 seconds. Drink one for every type you miss, and if you miss 5 or more, finish your drink and your new name is Joey.
cards.flavor: STIs are not like pokémon: you don't have to catch them all.

cards.title: Carpool
cards.text: Get in a crabwalk position. Choose any number of players to straddle you, and go to the other end of the room. Give out one shot for every player that does not fall off.

cards.title: Shirt Ninja
cards.text: You have become a ninja, and must wear your shirt as a ninja mask (over your head). Whenever someone looks into your eyes, they become the shirt ninja.

cards.title: Big Red Bitch Bag
cards.text: Find a paper bag, cut holes in it for eyes, and wear it.

cards.title: Ancient Chant
cards.text: Who wants to drink from the big container?

cards.title: Slow Clap
cards.text: Whenever you make eye contact with somebody, you have to slow clap for 10 seconds.

cards.title: Mr. Pinchy
cards.text: You must stand up and hold your hands up as lobster claws for one round.
cards.flavor: Dr. Bloopy says that this may be beneficial for your back.

cards.title: Man in the Mountain
cards.text: You have to stand with your back against the wall for one round.

cards.title: YOOOOOOUUUUU!
cards.text: Every time you talk to somebody, you must point to them with both hands and say YOU!

cards.title: Only Socks
cards.text: You must remove all of your clothing except for your socks (but you can wear your socks anywhere you want).

cards.title: Color Shot
cards.text: Take a shot and choose a color. All players must remove all clothing of that color.

cards.title: Search History
cards.text: Read out the last three things you searched for on your phone. Drink 2 for every one you skip.

cards.title: Mom's Last Text
cards.text: Read out the last text you got from a parent, word for word. If it has an emoji in it, everyone drinks 1.

cards.title: Emoji Autopsy
cards.text: Everyone opens their most-used emojis. Anyone whose top one is 😂 drinks 2. Anyone with 🍆, 🍑 or 💦 in their top row drinks 3 and explains.

cards.title: Photo Roulette
cards.text: Open your camera roll and scroll back exactly 47 photos. Show everyone, whatever it is. Or drink 5.

cards.title: Contact Roulette
cards.text: Read out the weirdest name saved in your contacts and explain who it is. Anyone with a contact saved as a warning, like "Don't Answer", drinks 2.

cards.title: Notes App
cards.text: Read out the most recent note on your phone, word for word. Or drink 4.
cards.flavor: Grocery lists are allowed. Poems are encouraged.

cards.title: Screen Time
cards.text: Everyone checks their screen time for this week. The highest drinks 1 for every 10 hours. The lowest gives out 3.

cards.title: Battery Check
cards.text: Everyone checks their phone battery. The lowest drinks 3. Anyone over 80% gives out 1 for being an adult.

cards.title: Passenger Rating
cards.text: Everyone checks their rating in a ride app. The lowest drinks 3. Anyone under 4.7 has to explain what they did.

cards.title: Spice Level
cards.text: Everyone who has ever sent a nude drinks 1. Anyone who has sent one to the wrong person finishes their drink and tells the story.

cards.title: Walk of Shame
cards.text: Tell the story of your most memorable walk of shame. If you've never done one, drink 3 and have a long look at your life.
cards.flavor: Shoes in hand, head held high.

cards.title: Backseat
cards.text: Everyone who has hooked up in a car drinks 2. In a moving car: drink 2 more. On a plane: finish your drink.

cards.title: Thin Walls
cards.text: Everyone who has been heard having sex by a roommate or neighbor drinks 2. Anyone who's been the roommate who heard it gives out 2 for their suffering.

cards.title: Walk-In
cards.text: Everyone who has walked in on someone having sex drinks 2. Everyone who has been walked in on drinks 3. If it was a parent, double it.

cards.title: Shower Thoughts
cards.text: Everyone who pees in the shower drinks 2. Everyone who says they don't drinks 3 for lying.

cards.title: Fart Amnesty
cards.text: If you've farted since the game started, admit it now and drink 1. Anyone caught later who didn't own up finishes their drink.

cards.title: The Blame Game
cards.text: For the rest of the game, whenever someone farts, everyone points at (or names) who they think did it. Whoever gets the most votes drinks 3, guilty or not.

cards.title: Toilet Tales
cards.text: Tell everyone your most disgusting bathroom story. Anyone who gags drinks 2.

cards.title: Burp the Alphabet
cards.text: Burp as much of the alphabet as you can in one go. Give out 1 drink for every letter you get through.

cards.title: Sex Noises
cards.text: Do an impression of your own sex noise. If anyone laughs, they drink 2. If nobody laughs, you drink 2, because that was a little too real.

cards.title: Coming Soon
cards.text: Describe the last time you had sex as a movie trailer, starting with "In a world…". Or drink 3.

cards.title: Rate My Ex
cards.text: Rate your last ex out of 10, out loud. Drink the difference between your number and 10.

cards.title: Kiss Math
cards.text: Count how many people you've kissed, divide by the number of players and round up. Drink that many.

cards.title: Exes in the Game
cards.text: Everyone who has hooked up with someone else in this game drinks 2. You don't have to say who. Yet.

cards.title: Bucket List
cards.text: Tell everyone the dirtiest thing on your bucket list. Anyone who's already done it gives out 2.

cards.title: Ghosted
cards.text: Everyone who has ever ghosted someone drinks 1. Everyone who got ghosted after a second date gives out 2 for their pain.

cards.title: Feet Pics
cards.text: Everyone rates their own feet out of 10, honestly. The group votes for the most overrated feet, and their owner drinks 3.
cards.flavor: There is a market for this.

cards.title: Commando
cards.text: Everyone who has gone commando to a wedding, a funeral or a job interview drinks 3.

cards.title: Underwear Check
cards.text: Everyone says what color underwear they're wearing. Anyone wearing none drinks 3. Anyone wearing a matching set drinks 2, because they had plans. Anyone who "doesn't remember" has to check.

cards.title: Hairy Situation
cards.text: Everyone who has shaved something and regretted it drinks 2. Anyone who's waxed anything below the belt gives out 2 for bravery.

cards.title: Dr. Google
cards.text: Everyone who has googled a rash drinks 2. Anyone who found out it was definitely something drinks 2 more.

cards.title: The Ex's Hoodie
cards.text: Everyone who still has clothes that belonged to an ex drinks 2. Anyone wearing them right now finishes their drink.

cards.title: Deep Stalk
cards.text: Everyone who has looked up an ex's new partner online drinks 2. Anyone who has accidentally liked an old photo while doing it drinks 4.

cards.title: Days Since
cards.text: Everyone says how many days it's been since they last hooked up. The highest number drinks 3. Anyone who says "today" drinks 3 too, for bragging.

cards.title: Worst Date
cards.text: Everyone sums up their worst date in one sentence. The group votes for the worst, and that player gives out 5 out of pity.

cards.title: Drunk Draft
cards.text: Write the text you'd send your ex at 2 a.m. and read it out loud. Don't send it. Drink 2 if anyone says "aww".

cards.title: Lost and Found
cards.text: Everyone drinks 1 for each of these they have lost on a night out: phone, keys, wallet, shoes, dignity.

cards.title: Hall Pass
cards.text: Everyone names their celebrity hall pass. Anyone whose pick is over 50 drinks 2. Anyone whose pick is a cartoon drinks 4.

cards.title: Two Truths and a Lay
cards.text: Say two true things and one lie about your sex life. Everyone who guesses wrong drinks 2. If everyone guesses right, you drink 4.

cards.title: Hot Seat
cards.text: For one minute, anyone can ask you anything. Every question you don't answer is a drink.

cards.title: The Confessional
cards.text: Confess something you've never told anyone playing. If the group decides it's boring, drink 3.

cards.title: Tell on Them
cards.text: Tell a story about another player that they'd rather you didn't. If they deny it, the group votes, and whoever loses drinks 3.

cards.title: Impressionist
cards.text: Do an impression of another player without saying who. If nobody guesses in three tries, drink 3. If someone gets it straight away, the player you did drinks 3.

cards.title: Roast Battle
cards.text: Pick another player. You each get 20 seconds to roast the other. The group picks the winner, and the loser drinks 4.

cards.title: The Haggler
cards.text: Pick a player and haggle over how many drinks they take, from 1 to 10. You both have to agree. If there's no deal in 30 seconds, you both drink 5.

cards.title: Dirty Joke
cards.text: Tell your dirtiest joke. If nobody laughs, drink 3. Anyone who groans drinks 1.

cards.title: Pheasant Plucker
cards.text: Say "I'm not a pheasant plucker, I'm a pheasant plucker's son" three times fast. Drink 1 for every slip. If something filthy comes out, give out 3.

cards.title: Things You Shouldn't Put in Your Butt
cards.text: Going in turn order from you, everyone names one. The first to hesitate, repeat one, or name something the group decides is actually fine, drinks 3.

cards.title: Kama Sutra
cards.text: Going in turn order from you, everyone names a sex position. The first to hesitate or repeat one drinks 3. Made-up ones count if you can describe them convincingly.

cards.title: Spirit Animal
cards.text: The group decides what animal you'd be in bed. Do its mating call, or drink 3.

cards.title: Safe Word
cards.text: Choose a safe word. Until your next turn, whenever anyone says it, everyone drinks 1.

cards.title: Lap Dance
cards.text: Give a chair a 10-second lap dance. Everyone rates it out of 10. Under 5 and you drink 3.

cards.title: Pickup Artist
cards.text: Use your best pickup line on the player of your choice. If they laugh or blush, they drink 2. If it bombs, you drink 2.

cards.title: Bedroom Eyes
cards.text: Give every player your best bedroom eyes, one at a time. Anyone who laughs drinks 1. If nobody laughs, you drink 2, because that was unsettling.

cards.title: Phone-Sex Voice
cards.text: Call or voice-note a parent and tell them you love them, in your best phone-sex voice. Or drink 5.

cards.title: Wrong Chat
cards.text: Send "I can't stop thinking about last night" to the third chat in your messages, with no explanation for 10 minutes. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Butt Dial
cards.text: Call the seventh person in your recent calls on speaker and ask what they're wearing. If they hang up, drink 2. If they answer, give out 4.

cards.title: Narrator
cards.text: Until your next turn, narrate everything you do in the third person, like a nature documentary. Drink 1 every time you forget.
cards.flavor: Here we see the drunk in its natural habitat.

cards.title: Excellent Choice
cards.text: Until your next turn, every time someone drinks, you have to say "Excellent choice" like a fancy waiter. Drink 1 every time you miss it.

cards.title: Echo
cards.text: Until your next turn, you have to repeat the last word of everything anyone says. Drink 1 for every one you miss.

cards.title: Sock Puppet
cards.text: Take off a sock and put it on your hand. Until your next turn, the sock does all your talking. Drink 1 every time you talk without it.

cards.title: Back in My Day
cards.text: Until your next turn, you're 90 years old. Complain about everything and start every sentence with "Back in my day". Drink 1 when you break character.

cards.title: Bathroom Key
cards.text: You hold the bathroom key. Until your next turn, anyone who needs to pee has to ask you first and do a little dance for permission.

cards.title: Bladder of Steel
cards.text: You can't go to the bathroom until after your next two turns. Take a shot to buy an early pass.
cards.flavor: Breaking the seal is for the weak.

cards.title: Freeze!
cards.text: Add this card to your hand. Any time you like, show it to everyone and shout "Freeze!". Everyone has to freeze, and the last one to do it drinks 3.

cards.title: Thumb Master
cards.text: Add this card to your hand. Any time you like, show it and quietly put your thumb on the table (or your forehead). The last person to copy you drinks 3.

cards.title: No U
cards.text: Add this card to your hand. The next time someone gives you drinks, show it, and they drink them instead.

cards.title: Interpretive Dance
cards.text: Perform an interpretive dance of your last relationship, from the first date to the breakup. Everyone guesses how it ended.

cards.title: Infomercial
cards.text: Grab the nearest object and sell it to everyone like a late-night infomercial for 30 seconds. If nobody would buy it, drink 3.

cards.title: Dramatic Reading
cards.text: Read your most recent email out loud as a dramatic monologue. Everyone who laughs drinks 1.

cards.title: Wedding Vows
cards.text: Write wedding vows to your drink and read them out loud. Then finish it on the honeymoon.
cards.flavor: Till death (or the hangover) do us part.

cards.title: Last Song Played
cards.text: Play the last song you listened to, out loud, right now. If it's embarrassing, drink 2. Anyone who sings along drinks 2 too.

cards.title: Add to Cart
cards.text: Show everyone the last thing you bought online. If it's weird, give out 3. If it's boring, drink 2. If you bought it drunk, finish your drink.

cards.title: Tattoo Tales
cards.text: Everyone with a tattoo tells its story. Anyone with a tattoo they regret drinks 3. Anyone with someone's name tattooed on them finishes their drink.

cards.title: Hidden Piercing
cards.text: Anyone with a piercing they can't show at work drinks 2. No, you don't have to show us. Unless you want to.

cards.title: Party Tricks
cards.text: Everyone with a weird body trick (double joints, wiggling ears, touching their nose with their tongue) shows it and gives out 2. Everyone else drinks 1.

cards.title: Ring Finger
cards.text: Everyone whose ring finger is longer than their index finger drinks 2. Science says it means something. We won't say what.

cards.title: Siblings
cards.text: Drink 1 for every sibling you have. Only children drink 3, because they're used to getting their own way.

cards.title: Birthday Buddies
cards.text: Everyone born in the same month as you drinks 3. If nobody shares your month, you drink 3.

cards.title: Star Signs
cards.text: Everyone says their star sign. The sign with the most people drinks 2. Anyone who says "I don't believe in that" drinks 1 for being such a Capricorn.

cards.title: Hot Take
cards.text: Share your most controversial food opinion. Everyone who disagrees drinks 1. If nobody disagrees, you drink 3 for being boring.
cards.flavor: Pineapple belongs on pizza. Fight me.

cards.title: Marry, Bang, Kill
cards.text: The next player names three people (players or celebrities). Say who you'd marry, bang and kill. Any player you kill drinks 3. Any player you bang gives out 2.

cards.title: Talk Show
cards.text: Interview the player of your choice like a late-night talk show host for one minute. Ask about their love life. They drink 1 for every question they dodge.

cards.title: Wrong Answers Only
cards.text: The next player asks you three questions. You can only give wrong answers. Drink 1 for every right one that slips out.

cards.title: Mirror Mode
cards.text: Pick a player. Until your next turn, copy every move they make. Drink 1 every time they catch you slacking.

cards.title: Polar Plunge
cards.text: Put an ice cube down your shirt and leave it there until it melts. Take a shot to put it down your pants instead, and give out 4.

cards.title: A Toast
cards.text: Make a toast to the player with the dirtiest mind here. Everyone drinks. They drink double.
cards.flavor: Here's to you, you filthy animal.

cards.title: Reality Star
cards.text: On three, everyone points at (or names) the player most likely to end up on a reality show. The player with the most votes drinks 3.

cards.title: Wi-Fi Password
cards.text: Read out your wifi password. If it's embarrassing, give out 3. If it's just random letters, drink 2 for being boring.

cards.title: Sniff Test
cards.text: Smell the armpit of the player of your choice and rate it out of 10. Under 5 and they drink 3. Refuse and you drink 5.

cards.title: Arm Wrestle
cards.text: Arm wrestle the player of your choice. The loser drinks 3. If you lose to someone smaller than you, drink 3 more.

cards.title: Human Coaster
cards.text: Lie down. The player of your choice uses your forehead as their coaster until your next turn. Every spill is a drink for them.

cards.title: Lap of Luxury
cards.text: Sit on the lap of the player of your choice until your next turn. If they say no, they drink 3.

cards.title: Red Hands
cards.text: Play slaps with the player of your choice. The first to get slapped three times drinks 3.

cards.title: Blind Taste Test
cards.text: Get blindfolded. The group feeds you three things from the kitchen. Guess them all, or drink 3.

cards.title: Massage Train
cards.text: Everyone gives the person in front of them a 30-second shoulder rub. Anyone who'd rather not drinks 2.

cards.title: Unlocked
cards.text: Hand your unlocked phone to the next player for 30 seconds. They can open one app of your choice (not the calculator). Or drink 5.

cards.title: Spoons
cards.text: Pick a player to spoon with until your next turn. You decide who's the big spoon. If they refuse, they drink 3.

cards.title: Slap Bet
cards.text: Make a slap bet with any player about something that'll happen tonight. The loser takes a slap on the hand (or the butt, winner's choice), or drinks 4.

cards.title: Pocket Check
cards.text: Everyone empties their pockets onto the table. Whoever has the weirdest thing gives out 4. Anyone with empty pockets drinks 2.

cards.title: Wrong Number
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to have sent a nude to the wrong person.
cards.secret: Well? Tell the story, or finish your drink. If it's never happened, the player who gave you this drinks 3 for assuming.

cards.title: Worst Kisser
cards.text: Give this card to the player you think is the worst kisser. They won't know why. Probably.
cards.secret: You were picked as the worst kisser. Make out with the back of your hand for 5 seconds to prove them wrong. If the group says you're actually good, the player who gave you this drinks 4.

cards.title: Freak in the Sheets
cards.text: Give this card to the biggest freak in the bedroom.
cards.secret: The player who gave you this thinks you're the biggest freak in bed. Confirm it with one example, or deny it and drink 3.

cards.title: Search Party
cards.text: Give this card to the player with the dirtiest search history.
cards.secret: Read out your last three searches, word for word. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Trust Issues
cards.text: Give this card to the player you trust the least.
cards.secret: Until your next turn, you can only tell lies. Anyone who catches you telling the truth gives you a drink.

cards.title: Stuck in an Elevator
cards.text: Give this card to the player you'd most like to be stuck in an elevator with.
cards.secret: Aww. Stare into the eyes of the player who gave you this (through the camera counts) for 10 seconds. If either of you laughs, you both drink 2. If not, you both give out 3.

cards.title: Lightweight
cards.text: Give this card to the biggest lightweight here.
cards.secret: Prove them wrong: take a big drink. If you're honestly feeling it already, drink a glass of water instead, and the player who gave you this drinks for you.

cards.title: Thick Skin
cards.text: Give this card to the player who can take a joke the best.
cards.secret: Everyone roasts you, one sentence each, in turn order. Then you give out 5 drinks to whoever was meanest.

cards.title: Hottest in the Room
cards.text: Give this card to the player you secretly think is the hottest. Don't worry, it's sealed. They'll never know.
cards.secret: Surprise: you were picked as the hottest player. The player who gave you this has to explain why, out loud, in detail. Or they finish their drink. (We lied about them never knowing.)

cards.title: Bad Influence
cards.text: Give this card to the player who's the worst influence on you.
cards.secret: Live up to it: pick a dare for the player who gave you this. If they won't do it, they drink 4.

cards.title: Bouncer's Nightmare
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to get kicked out of a bar.
cards.secret: Tell everyone the worst thing you've done on a night out. If the group says it's the worst they've heard tonight, give out 4. If not, drink 3.

cards.title: Mystery Guest
cards.text: Give this card to the player you know the least about.
cards.secret: Tell everyone three things they don't know about you. At least one has to be dirty. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Oversharer
cards.text: Give this card to the biggest oversharer here.
cards.secret: Prove it: share something you've never told anyone playing. Or drink 4 and keep your secrets, coward.

cards.title: Innocent Angel
cards.text: Give this card to the most innocent player.
cards.secret: Innocent, are we? Everyone asks you one dirty question each. Every one you won't answer is a drink.

cards.title: Party Pooper
cards.text: Give this card to the player who's been the most boring tonight.
cards.secret: Ouch. Do something wild that the group picks, or finish your drink. Then the player who gave you this has to compliment you three times.

cards.title: That Laugh
cards.text: Give this card to the player with the most ridiculous laugh.
cards.secret: Do your laugh on purpose, as loud as you can, for 5 seconds. Everyone who laughs drinks 1. Until your next turn, the player who gave you this has to laugh exactly like you.

cards.title: Best Dressed
cards.text: Give this card to the best-dressed player.
cards.secret: Swap one piece of clothing with the player who gave you this. You both wear it until your next turn. Or you both drink 3.

cards.title: Getting Lucky
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to hook up with someone tonight.
cards.secret: Whisper (or text) to the player who gave you this the name of who you'd pick, out of everyone playing. If it's them, you both finish your drinks. They can't tell anyone.

cards.title: Ex Alert
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to text an ex tonight.
cards.secret: Mute or archive your ex's chat right now, in front of everyone. Or drink 4. The player who gave you this gets to check.

cards.title: Cheapskate
cards.text: Give this card to the stingiest player.
cards.secret: Prove you're generous: give out 6 drinks, split however you like. The player who gave you this has to take at least 2 of them.

cards.title: Dirty Mind
cards.text: Give this card to the player with the dirtiest mind.
cards.secret: Say the first thing that comes to mind for each word: banana, hole, wood, balls, cream. Give out 1 drink for every answer the group decides is dirty.

cards.title: Put a Ring on It
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to get married first.
cards.secret: Propose to the player who gave you this, on one knee, with a ring made from whatever you can find. If they say yes, everyone drinks to the happy couple. If they say no, drink 3 and cry.

cards.title: Group Mom
cards.text: Give this card to the mom (or dad) of the group.
cards.secret: Hydration check: everyone drinks some water, right now, while you watch. Then give out 3 for all the times you've held someone's hair back.

cards.title: Gossip
cards.text: Give this card to the biggest gossip here.
cards.secret: Spill one bit of harmless gossip about anyone playing. If it's about the player who gave you this, they drink 4. If you won't, you drink 4.

cards.title: Gym Rat
cards.text: Give this card to the strongest player.
cards.secret: Do 10 push-ups, right now. Drink 1 for every one you can't do. The player who gave you this has to count out loud and cheer.

cards.title: Big Flirt
cards.text: Give this card to the biggest flirt here.
cards.secret: Flirt with the player who gave you this for 30 seconds, using only food puns. If they laugh, they drink 2. If they blush, they finish their drink.

cards.title: Certified Weirdo
cards.text: Give this card to the weirdest player here, and mean it.
cards.secret: Embrace it: do the weirdest thing you can think of for 10 seconds. If the group agrees it was weird enough, the player who gave you this drinks 3. If not, you do.

cards.title: Zombie Plan
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to survive a zombie apocalypse.
cards.secret: Pick one other player for your survival team. You both give out 3. Then pick the player who'd get eaten first: they drink 3.

cards.title: Picky Eater
cards.text: Give this card to the pickiest eater here.
cards.secret: The group picks something from your kitchen for you to eat a bite of. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Bed Buddy
cards.text: Give this card to the player you'd least want to share a bed with.
cards.secret: Confess your worst sleeping habit. If the player who gave you this has ever shared a bed with you, they have to back you up, and you both drink 2.

cards.title: Best Kisser
cards.text: Give this card to the player you think is the best kisser.
cards.secret: Tell everyone who taught you. Then, if you've ever kissed the player who gave you this, you both drink 3. (Now everyone knows.)

cards.title: Side Hustle
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to have a secret OnlyFans.
cards.secret: Do you? Either way, describe what you'd post in one sentence. Everyone who'd subscribe drinks 1.

cards.title: Snitch
cards.text: Give this card to the player who'd snitch first in a police interview.
cards.secret: Prove it: tell everyone one thing another player did that they'd rather keep quiet. They drink 3. If you won't snitch, you drink 3.

cards.title: Kinky
cards.text: Give this card to the player who probably has the weirdest kink.
cards.secret: Name one weird turn-on. If you won't, the player who gave you this guesses it out loud, and you have to say whether they're right.

cards.title: Fake It
cards.text: Give this card to the player who's best at faking it.
cards.secret: Faking what, exactly? Do your best fake laugh, fake cry and fake orgasm, 3 seconds each. The player who gave you this picks the most convincing one. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Class Clown
cards.text: Give this card to the funniest player.
cards.secret: You have 30 seconds to make the player who gave you this laugh. If they laugh, they drink 3. If they keep a straight face, you drink 3.

cards.title: Getaway Driver
cards.text: Give this card to the player you'd pick as your getaway driver.
cards.secret: You're in the crew. Until your next turn, whenever you or the player who gave you this drinks, the other one drinks too.

cards.title: Future Millionaire
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to be a millionaire one day.
cards.secret: Spend it: give out 7 drinks however you like. Then promise the player who gave you this a cut, out loud, in front of witnesses.

cards.title: Ice Cold
cards.text: Give this card to the coldest-hearted player.
cards.secret: Say one genuinely nice thing about every player. Drink 1 for every one you can't say with a straight face.

cards.title: Dry Spell
cards.text: Give this card to the player who's gone the longest without sex.
cards.secret: How long has it been? Drink 1 for every month (up to 5). If it's been less than a week, the player who gave you this drinks 3 for getting it so wrong.

cards.title: Crybaby
cards.text: Give this card to the player most likely to cry at a movie.
cards.secret: Name the last movie that made you cry. Everyone who cried at it too drinks 1. If you won't admit to one, drink 3.

cards.title: Lucky Dip
cards.text: Give this card to anyone. Don't think too hard.
cards.secret: Lucky you: give out 5 drinks. The player who gave you this has to take at least 2.

cards.title: Return to Sender
cards.text: Give this card to the player you most want to see drink.
cards.secret: Return to sender: the player who gave you this drinks 4. Enjoy watching.

cards.title: Puppet Master
cards.text: Give this card to the player you'd most like to control.
cards.secret: You're the puppet. Until your next turn, the player who gave you this can give you one command each turn (nothing dangerous, nothing illegal). Refuse one and drink 3.

cards.title: Wingman
cards.text: Give this card to the player who'd be the best wingman.
cards.secret: Write a dating profile for the player who gave you this, out loud, in three sentences. Everyone votes: if they'd swipe right, you both give out 2. If not, you both drink 2.

cards.title: Psychic
cards.text: Give this card to the player you think is thinking about sex right now.
cards.secret: Were you? Be honest. If yes, the player who gave you this gives out 3 for reading minds. If no, they drink 3 for projecting.

cards.title: Body Count
cards.text: Give this card to the player whose body count you'd most like to know.
cards.secret: Don't say it yet. Everyone else guesses your number out loud. The closest guess gives out 3. Then reveal it, or drink 4 to keep the mystery.

cards.title: Look-Alike
cards.text: Give this card to the player who looks the most like a celebrity.
cards.secret: The player who gave you this has to say which celebrity, out loud. If you like the answer, they drink 1. If you hate it, they finish their drink.

cards.title: Main Character
cards.text: Give this card to the player with the most main-character energy.
cards.secret: Until your next turn, everyone has to narrate what you do like you're the star of a movie. Anyone who forgets drinks 1.

cards.title: Payback
cards.text: Give this card to the player who's made you drink the most tonight.
cards.secret: Payback: drink 4, courtesy of the player who gave you this. No refunds.

cards.title: Fridge Tour
cards.text: Give everyone a 30-second tour of your fridge. The group picks the saddest thing in it. Eat a bite, or drink 3.

cards.title: Background Check
cards.text: Everyone shows the room behind them. The messiest one drinks 3. Anyone using a fake background drinks 2 for hiding something.

cards.title: Bed Reveal
cards.text: Show everyone your bed on camera, right now, as it is. Unmade: drink 2. Someone in it: explain.

cards.title: Bathroom Cabinet
cards.text: Open your bathroom cabinet on camera. The group picks one thing in it, and you explain why you have it. Or drink 3.

cards.title: Under the Bed
cards.text: Show everyone what's under your bed or couch. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Top Drawer
cards.text: Open your bedside drawer on camera. Or drink 5, which tells us everything anyway.

cards.title: Laundry Day
cards.text: Pull the first thing out of your laundry basket and hold it up to the camera. Underwear: give out 3. Socks: drink 2.

cards.title: Toilet Cam
cards.text: Take everyone to your bathroom and show them your toilet. Rate how clean it is out of 10, then drink 10 minus your score.
cards.flavor: Be honest. We can see it.

cards.title: Stink Hunt
cards.text: Everyone has 60 seconds to bring the worst-smelling thing they can find back to the camera. The group picks the winner, who gives out 4. The last one back drinks 3.

cards.title: Shape Hunt
cards.text: Everyone has 60 seconds to find something shaped like a penis and hold it up to the camera. The most convincing one gives out 4. The last one back drinks 3.

cards.title: Mom Can't See This
cards.text: Everyone has 60 seconds to find the thing they'd least want their mom to see, and show it on camera. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Expiration Date
cards.text: Everyone has 60 seconds to find the oldest food in their kitchen and read out the date. The oldest gives out 4. Anyone brave enough to sniff it gives out 2 more.

cards.title: Show and Tell
cards.text: Go get the weirdest thing you own and explain it to the camera in 30 seconds. If the group says it isn't weird enough, drink 3.

cards.title: Arm's Reach
cards.text: Everyone grabs the nearest thing they can reach without getting up and holds it to the camera. The weirdest gives out 3. If anyone's holding something from the bedside drawer, they finish their drink.

cards.title: Pet Cameo
cards.text: Everyone with a pet brings it on camera and says what it's thinking about everyone on the call. Anyone without one has to be a pet for 10 seconds instead.

cards.title: Roommate Roulette
cards.text: Shout for whoever else is home to come and say hi on camera. If they come, give out 4. If you're home alone, drink 2, you lonely legend.

cards.title: Phone a Friend
cards.text: Add someone who isn't playing to the call for one minute. They have to say something nice about you. If you can't get anyone, drink 3.

cards.title: Mom Cam
cards.text: Call a parent on speaker and ask what they think you're doing right now. Or drink 4.

cards.title: Wardrobe Change
cards.text: You have 2 minutes to change into the most ridiculous outfit you own. If you come back looking normal, drink 4.

cards.title: Ugly Closet
cards.text: Everyone holds up the ugliest piece of clothing they own. The group votes for the worst, and its owner wears it until the end of the game.

cards.title: Freeze Frame
cards.text: Freeze like your video's stuck. Stay perfectly still until someone notices and says your name. If nobody notices in 30 seconds, everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Bad Connection
cards.text: Until your next turn, answer everything 3 seconds late, like your internet is terrible. Drink 1 every time you answer on time.

cards.title: You're on Mute
cards.text: For the rest of the game, anyone who talks while they're muted drinks 3 as soon as someone shouts "YOU'RE ON MUTE!"

cards.title: Can You Hear Me?
cards.text: For the rest of the game, anyone who says "can you hear me?", "you're frozen" or "you're breaking up" drinks 1.

cards.title: Mute Button
cards.text: Pick a player. They mute themselves until your next turn and can only talk with gestures. They drink 1 every time they unmute.

cards.title: Peekaboo
cards.text: Turn your camera off. Until your next turn, you can only come back on camera to drink, and you have to shout "PEEKABOO!" every time.

cards.title: Ghost
cards.text: Leave the call without warning, then come back 30 seconds later like nothing happened. Anyone who asks where you went drinks 2.

cards.title: Army Crawl
cards.text: Leave the camera and come back crawling into the shot like a soldier on a mission. Anyone who laughs drinks 1.

cards.title: Face Cam
cards.text: Put your face as close to your camera as it will go and keep it there for one minute while everyone talks to you. Pull back early and drink 3.

cards.title: Upside Down
cards.text: Turn your phone or camera upside down until your next turn. Drink 1 every time you fix it.

cards.title: New Name
cards.text: The group renames you on the video call. Keep that name until the end of the game. Drink 3 if you change it back.

cards.title: Filter Fail
cards.text: Turn on the silliest camera filter you can find and leave it on until your next turn. No filters? Draw a mustache on a sticky note and stick it on.

cards.title: Screenshot
cards.text: Count down from three and take a screenshot of the call. Everyone has to pull their worst face. Whoever looks worst drinks 2, and the screenshot goes in the group chat.

cards.title: Glass Check
cards.text: Everyone holds their glass up to the camera. The emptiest glass gets refilled and its owner drinks 2. The fullest drinks 2 for slacking.

cards.title: Virtual Cheers
cards.text: Everyone raises a glass to the camera and drinks. The last person to raise theirs drinks 2 more.

cards.title: Pour Decisions
cards.text: Everyone shows the camera what they're drinking. The group votes for the saddest drink, and its owner drinks 3. The fanciest gives out 2.

cards.title: TV Bartender
cards.text: Make a cocktail out of whatever food and drink is in your kitchen, live on camera, narrating like a TV chef. Then drink it.

cards.title: Snack Attack
cards.text: Eat the snack closest to you on camera, as seductively as you can, for 15 seconds. No snacks? A spoonful of any sauce.

cards.title: Silent Movie
cards.text: Mute yourself and act out a movie on camera. The first person to guess it gives out 2. If nobody gets it in a minute, drink 3.

cards.title: Silent Disco
cards.text: Everyone mutes. You play a song only you can hear and dance to it on camera. The first person to guess the song gives out 3. If nobody does, drink 2.

cards.title: Corporate Mode
cards.text: Until your next turn, everyone talks like this is a work meeting: "circle back", "synergy", "let's take this offline". Anyone who says something normal drinks 1.

cards.title: Raise Your Hand
cards.text: Until your next turn, anyone who wants to speak has to raise their hand on camera and wait for you to call on them. Talking out of turn is a drink.

cards.title: Chat Race
cards.text: Everyone types "I have the dirtiest mind on this call" in the call's chat. The last to send it drinks 2. Anyone who makes a typo drinks 1.

cards.title: Window Watch
cards.text: Point your camera out of the nearest window and narrate what you see like a nature documentary for 20 seconds. Or drink 3.

cards.title: Doorbell
cards.text: Go to your front door, knock on it, then open it to yourself on camera and act very surprised to see you.

cards.title: Lights Out
cards.text: Turn off the lights and hold your phone's flashlight under your chin. Tell everyone your dirtiest secret like it's a ghost story.

cards.title: Draw Me
cards.text: Draw a portrait of the player of your choice in 30 seconds and hold it up to the camera. If they hate it, they drink 2. If everyone loves it, give out 3.

cards.title: News Desk
cards.text: Report live on what everyone on the call is doing right now, like a breaking-news anchor, for 30 seconds.

cards.title: Book Club
cards.text: Grab the nearest book (or anything with words on it) and read a random sentence to the camera in your sexiest voice.

cards.title: Picture Frame
cards.text: Show everyone the nearest photo on your walls or shelves and tell the story behind it. If you're in it, drink 2 for vanity.

cards.title: Drink Coupon
cards.text: Play it when you're told to drink, and don't. Good for one drink, any time tonight.

cards.title: Pass the Buck
cards.text: Play it when you're told to drink. Point at anyone else: they drink it for you.

cards.title: Objection!
cards.text: Play it right after someone shows a card. Nobody has to do it, and whoever showed it drinks 2 instead.

cards.title: Tattletale
cards.text: Play it the second you catch someone breaking a rule from an earlier card. They drink 3, and you get to say "I'm telling" in your most annoying voice.

cards.title: Chicken Exit
cards.text: Play it to get out of any dare. You still have to do the chicken dance while everyone clucks at you.

cards.title: Truth Bomb
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They answer one question of your choice, honestly, or finish their drink.

cards.title: Double Dare
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They do a dare of your choice (nothing that needs a hospital or a lawyer), or drink 4.

cards.title: Body Double
cards.text: Play it when you get a dare. Pick someone to do it for you. They can get out of it by drinking 3, and you're off the hook either way.

cards.title: Drinking Buddy
cards.text: Play it on anyone. Until your next turn, every time you drink, they drink too.

cards.title: Toastmaster
cards.text: Play it any time. Everyone raises their glass to a toast you make up on the spot, the filthier the better. Last glass up drinks 2.

cards.title: Simon Says
cards.text: Play it to become Simon until your next turn. Anyone who messes up a "Simon says", or follows an order without it, drinks 1.

cards.title: Plus One
cards.text: Play it when someone else is told to drink. They drink double.

cards.title: Dirty Laundry
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They tell a secret nobody here knows yet. If the group votes it boring, they drink 3 and try again.

cards.title: Group Chat Leak
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They read out the last message they sent in their busiest group chat, no context allowed, or drink 4.

cards.title: Camera Roll
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They show everyone the 7th most recent photo on their phone, or drink 4.

cards.title: Bottoms Up
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They finish what's in their glass.

cards.title: Surprise Waterfall
cards.text: Play it any time to start a waterfall with you. Everyone drinks, and nobody can stop until the person before them stops.

cards.title: Sip Insurance
cards.text: Play it when you're told to drink 3 or more. You only drink 1.

cards.title: Immunity Idol
cards.text: Play it when a card makes everyone drink. Everyone except you.

cards.title: Drink Tax
cards.text: Play it any time. Every other player drinks 1, just because you said so.

cards.title: Rubber and Glue
cards.text: Play it right after someone roasts you. It bounces off you and sticks to them: they drink 2.

cards.title: Swear Jar
cards.text: Play it on anyone. Until your next turn, every time they swear, they drink 1.

cards.title: Lock Jaw
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They can't say a word until your next turn. Every word that slips out is a drink.

cards.title: Accent Lock
cards.text: Play it on anyone. Until your next turn, they talk like a pirate, a cowboy or a sports commentator (your pick). Every slip is a drink.

cards.title: Dibs
cards.text: Play it when a card tells someone else to pick a player. You make the pick instead.

cards.title: Lie Detector
cards.text: Play it right after someone answers a question. They look you in the eye and say it again. If they laugh or look away, they drink 3.

cards.title: Rewind
cards.text: Play it right after someone finishes a dare. They do it again, in slow motion, while you narrate.

cards.title: Spill It
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They tell the story of their most embarrassing hookup, or drink 4.

cards.title: New Law
cards.text: Play it any time to make a rule that lasts until your next turn. Anyone who breaks it drinks 1.

cards.title: Cockblock
cards.text: Play it when two players are flirting, cuddling or about to kiss because of a card. They have to stop, and both drink 2.

cards.title: Last Call
cards.text: Play it any time. Everyone has 10 seconds to drink as much as they can. Whoever drank the least drinks 2 more.

cards.title: Water Break
cards.text: Play it any time. Everyone drinks some water. Anyone who complains drinks 1 of their real drink.

cards.title: Shame Bell
cards.text: Play it on anyone who just chickened out of a card. Everyone chants "Shame!" while they drink 2.

cards.title: Drunk Dial
cards.text: Play it on anyone. They text "thinking about you 😉" to the 5th person in their recent messages, or drink 5.

cards.title: Heckler
cards.text: Play it while someone is doing a dare or answering a question. You heckle them the whole time. If they laugh or stop, they drink 2.

cards.title: Bodyguard
cards.text: Play it when someone else is told to drink. You drink it for them, and they owe you a favor of your choice before the night's over.

cards.title: Interrogator
cards.text: Play it to become the Interrogator until your next turn. Anyone who answers a question you ask drinks 1.

cards.title: Rock Paper Shots
cards.text: Play it on anyone. Rock, paper, scissors, best of three. The loser takes a shot (or drinks 3).

cards.title: Double or Nothing
cards.text: Play it when someone is told to drink. They call heads or tails and flip a coin: right, they drink nothing; wrong, they drink double.

cards.title: Phone Jail
cards.text: Play it on anyone. Their phone goes face down in the middle until your next turn. Every time they touch it, they drink 2.
